intent: Moved sensors further forward and widened lateral spread to improve early line detection and lateral coverage, aiming to reduce line loss and stalls. Maintained sensor size at 0.016 m and wheel track at 0.12 m for turning agility. Kept body length at 0.20 m for stability and off-track tolerance. Expect these geometry changes to support the integrator's plan to reduce base speed to 1.1 and increase integral gain to 0.4, resulting in fewer stalls, better steady-state control, and improved race progress.
rationale: The latest race data and integrator feedback indicate persistent early stalls and line loss events despite previous geometry adjustments. The integrator suggests reducing base speed to 1.1 and increasing integral gain to 0.4 to improve steady-state control and prevent stalls. To support these controller changes, I further move the sensors slightly forward and widen their lateral spread within allowed limits to enhance early line detection and lateral coverage. Sensor size remains at the maximum 0.016 m for best line sensing. Wheel track is kept at 0.12 m to maintain turning agility, and body length remains at 0.20 m for stability and off-track tolerance. Body width and mass are unchanged to preserve handling balance. I expect these geometry changes combined with the integrator's controller tuning to reduce stalls and line loss events, improve progress, and enhance overall race performance.
